outputAuthoring.locked.zh-CN: 请等待当前操作完成，并应用画布改动后再编辑结果。
outputAuthoring.locked.en-US: Finish the current operation and apply graph changes before editing outputs.

indicatorParameters.editorHint.zh-CN: 先完成公式或应用画布，再识别可调输入。未开放的输入保持固定；同值常量不会自动合并。
indicatorParameters.editorHint.en-US: Complete the formula or apply the canvas, then inspect eligible inputs. Unopened inputs stay fixed; equal constants are not automatically linked.

indicatorParameters.showUsage.zh-CN: 查看公式中的使用位置

indicatorParameters.noCandidates.zh-CN: 没有其他可开放的输入。数据输入和公式结构常量保持固定。
indicatorParameters.noCandidates.en-US: No other eligible inputs. Data inputs and structural constants stay fixed.

indicatorParameters.confirmFix.zh-CN: 将“{{name}}”的全部引用固定为默认值？保存指标后生效，历史版本不变。
indicatorParameters.confirmFix.en-US: Fix all references to “{{name}}” at its default? This takes effect after saving; historical revisions stay unchanged.

indicatorParameters.pending.zh-CN: 参数设置尚未应用，请先应用再校验或保存指标。
indicatorParameters.pending.en-US: Apply these parameter settings before validating or saving the indicator.

indicatorParameters.definitionError.zh-CN: 请填写名称及合法数值；默认值必须在范围内并符合类型、步长，步长必须大于 0。
indicatorParameters.definitionError.en-US: Enter a name and valid values. The default must match the range, type and step; step must be positive.

indicatorParameters.requestError.zh-CN: 参数操作失败，请检查公式后重试。
indicatorParameters.requestError.en-US: Parameter operation failed. Check the formula and retry.

indicatorParameters.applyCanvasFirst.zh-CN: 请先完成当前操作并应用画布，再设置参数。
indicatorParameters.applyCanvasFirst.en-US: Complete the current operation and apply the canvas before editing parameters.

indicatorParameters.runtimeHint.zh-CN: 修改后点击应用；仅影响当前页面，不修改指标默认值。
indicatorParameters.runtimeHint.en-US: Apply after editing. Changes affect this page only, not the indicator defaults.

indicatorParameters.error.required.zh-CN: 请输入参数值，不能留空。
indicatorParameters.error.required.en-US: Enter a value; this field cannot be empty.

indicatorParameters.error.integer.en-US: This parameter must be an integer.

indicatorParameters.error.range.en-US: The value is outside the allowed range.

indicatorParameters.error.step.zh-CN: 请从最小值起按指定步长取值。
indicatorParameters.error.step.en-US: Use the specified step starting at the minimum.

indicatorParameters.parameterNode.zh-CN: 可变参数：{{code}}。默认值和范围在计算参数面板设置。
indicatorParameters.parameterNode.en-US: Adjustable parameter: {{code}}. Edit its default and range in Calculation parameters.

indicatorParameters.connectionError.zh-CN: 可变参数只能连接系统允许的算子参数位置。
indicatorParameters.connectionError.en-US: Adjustable parameters can connect only to eligible operator inputs.

indicatorParameters.fixedHint.zh-CN: 此版本未开放可变参数，按固定公式计算。
indicatorParameters.fixedHint.en-US: This revision has no adjustable parameters and uses its fixed formula.

i18n.matrix.finishCell.zh-CN: 正在编辑单元格：按 Enter 确认或 Esc 取消后，再保存或切换页面。
i18n.matrix.finishCell.en-US: Editing a cell: press Enter to commit or Esc to cancel before saving or changing views.

i18n.matrix.batchLimit.zh-CN: 单次最多修改 1000 个单元格，请先保存当前修改。此次粘贴未应用。
i18n.matrix.batchLimit.en-US: Edit up to 1,000 cells per batch. Save the current changes first. This paste was not applied.

i18n.matrix.hint.zh-CN: 第一列是稳定代码，每列是一种语言。双击或按 Enter 编辑；方向键移动，Shift＋点击选择区域，可粘贴 Excel 矩形区域。修改后统一保存。
i18n.matrix.hint.en-US: Stable codes stay in the first column. Double-click or press Enter to edit. Use arrows to navigate, Shift+click to select, and paste rectangular Excel ranges. Save changes together.

i18n.matrix.readOnlyHint.zh-CN: 系统语言包只读；缺少内置译文时明确显示回退内容，不把回退值记为已翻译。
i18n.matrix.readOnlyHint.en-US: System language packs are read-only. Missing translations show a fallback preview, not a completed translation.

i18n.matrix.editHint.zh-CN: Enter 确认，Shift＋Enter 换行，Esc 取消本次编辑。清空译文恢复默认。
i18n.matrix.editHint.en-US: Enter commits, Shift+Enter inserts a line, Esc cancels this edit. Clear text to restore the default.

i18n.matrix.pasteInvalid.zh-CN: 粘贴区域无效或超过当前页/语言列范围，未应用任何修改。请只复制译文区域，不要包含表头或系统代码。
i18n.matrix.pasteInvalid.en-US: Invalid paste or range exceeds this page/language columns. Nothing changed. Copy translation cells only, without headers or system codes.

i18n.matrix.invalidCell.zh-CN: 译文超长、含不允许内容或占位符不匹配；未应用修改。
i18n.matrix.invalidCell.en-US: Translation is too long, contains disallowed content or has mismatched placeholders. No changes applied.

i18n.matrix.languagesSaved.zh-CN: 语言列已保存，现有译文和计算定义不变。
i18n.matrix.languagesSaved.en-US: Language columns saved. Existing translations and calculations are unchanged.

i18n.matrix.languageExample.en-US: For example ja-JP, fr-FR or zh-Hant-TW

i18n.matrix.addHint.zh-CN: 新增的是业务译文列，不会自动翻译。没有系统语言包时，菜单使用所选内置回退语言。语言代码保存后不可改名或删除，可停用并保留译文。
i18n.matrix.addHint.en-US: A new business translation column is not automatic translation. Menus use the selected built-in fallback when no system pack exists. Saved codes cannot be renamed or deleted; disable to retain translations.

i18n.matrix.languageInvalid.zh-CN: 请填写有效且不重复的语言代码和名称。最多 24 种语言。
i18n.matrix.languageInvalid.en-US: Enter a valid unique language code and name. Up to 24 languages.

i18n.matrix.saveFirst.zh-CN: 请先保存或取消译文草稿，再修改语言列。
i18n.matrix.saveFirst.en-US: Save or discard translation drafts before managing language columns.

i18n.matrix.pendingOutside.zh-CN: 其他分类或页面中仍有未保存的译文。
i18n.matrix.pendingOutside.en-US: Other categories or pages contain unsaved translations.

errors.I18N_DUPLICATE_LOCALE.en-US: This language code is already registered.

errors.I18N_BUILTIN_LOCALE_LOCKED.zh-CN: 内置语言不能修改或停用。
errors.I18N_BUILTIN_LOCALE_LOCKED.en-US: Built-in languages cannot be changed or disabled.

errors.I18N_DEFAULT_LOCALE_DISABLED.zh-CN: 请先更换工作区默认语言，再停用该语言。
errors.I18N_DEFAULT_LOCALE_DISABLED.en-US: Change the workspace default before disabling this language.

errors.I18N_LOCALE_UNKNOWN.zh-CN: 请先添加对应语言列，再填写或导入译文。
errors.I18N_LOCALE_UNKNOWN.en-US: Add the language column before editing or importing translations.

errors.I18N_LOCALE_DELETE_FORBIDDEN.zh-CN: 语言不能删除，可停用并保留译文。
errors.I18N_LOCALE_DELETE_FORBIDDEN.en-US: Languages cannot be deleted. Disable them to retain translations.

i18n.refreshReview.zh-CN: 已刷新当前译文，未保存修改已保留。请检查修改预览后再保存。
i18n.refreshReview.en-US: Translations refreshed. Your unsaved changes are preserved. Review the preview before saving.

navigation.directoryHint.zh-CN: 选择一个流程节点进入对应工作区。已有能力直接复用，静态演示节点使用预置示例数据呈现未来功能与交互边界。
navigation.directoryHint.en-US: Choose a workflow step to open its workspace. Available features are operational; prototype steps illustrate planned functionality using sample data.

graph.restoreHint.zh-CN: 不会用旧公式覆盖当前输入。可返回高级公式模式修复，或重新构建。
graph.restoreHint.en-US: Your current input will not be replaced by an older formula. Fix it in the formula editor, or start again.

graph.messages.changed.zh-CN: 画布已修改。检查并应用后，才能保存或预览新计算。
graph.messages.changed.en-US: Graph changed. Check and apply it before saving or previewing the new calculation.

graph.messages.restoring.zh-CN: 正在从当前公式还原画布…
graph.messages.restoring.en-US: Restoring the graph from the current formula…

graph.messages.restoreFailed.zh-CN: 当前公式暂不能还原。可以返回公式模式修复，或从空白画布重新构建。
graph.messages.restoreFailed.en-US: This formula cannot be restored as a graph. Fix it in the formula editor or start with an empty graph.

graph.messages.ready.zh-CN: 从左到右：输入数据 → 计算步骤 → 最终输出。点击任一步骤即可修改。
graph.messages.ready.en-US: Read left to right: inputs → calculation steps → final outputs. Click any step to edit it.

graph.messages.incomplete.zh-CN: 请先补全标记的输入与输出。
graph.messages.incomplete.en-US: Complete the marked inputs and outputs first.

graph.messages.invalid.zh-CN: 画布未通过检查。点击问题可定位需要修改的步骤。
graph.messages.invalid.en-US: Graph validation failed. Select an issue to locate the affected step.

graph.messages.applied.zh-CN: 画布已应用到指标草稿。保存指标或前往“校验与预览”运行真实计算。
graph.messages.applied.en-US: Graph applied to the indicator draft. Save the indicator or open Validation and preview to calculate.

graph.messages.valid.zh-CN: 结构与类型检查通过；尚未编译或执行数值计算。
graph.messages.valid.en-US: Structure and types are valid. No numerical compilation or calculation has been performed.

graph.messages.layoutSaved.zh-CN: 画布布局已保存，指标版本和计算结果不变。
graph.messages.layoutSaved.en-US: Layout saved. The indicator revision and calculation results are unchanged.

graph.messages.blank.zh-CN: 空白画布：先添加数据和算子，再连接到最终输出。
graph.messages.blank.en-US: Empty graph: add data and operators, then connect the final output.

graph.selectInput.en-US: Choose an upstream step or constant

graph.outputIdentifierHint.zh-CN: 字母或下划线开头，可含数字；用于区分输出通道。
graph.outputIdentifierHint.en-US: Start with a letter or underscore; digits are allowed. Identifies the output channel.

graph.outputIdentifierError.zh-CN: 通道标识不能重复，只能使用字母、数字或下划线，且不能以数字开头。
graph.outputIdentifierError.en-US: Use a unique channel identifier containing letters, digits and underscores; it must not start with a digit.

graph.outputPlacementHint.zh-CN: 图表位置由使用指标的研究页面决定，此处只定义计算和数值展示。
graph.outputPlacementHint.en-US: The research page decides where charts appear. This editor defines calculations and number presentation only.

graph.selectStep.zh-CN: 点击画布中的步骤或输出，查看输入、设置常量及选择上游。
graph.selectStep.en-US: Select a step or output to inspect inputs, configure constants and choose upstream steps.

graph.sharedHint.zh-CN: 这个步骤被 {{count}} 处引用。修改会影响所有下游；只改一条分支时，请复制步骤后重新连接。
graph.sharedHint.en-US: This step has {{count}} references. Editing affects all consumers. Duplicate and reconnect it to change only one branch.

graph.booleanHint.zh-CN: 判断值（选中为“是”，未选中为“否”）

graph.deleteHint.zh-CN: 删除会断开下游输入，可通过“撤销”恢复。
graph.deleteHint.en-US: Deleting disconnects downstream inputs. Undo restores them.

graph.constantHint.zh-CN: 固定数值写入指标版本，不随运行条件变化。
graph.constantHint.en-US: The constant is fixed in the indicator revision and does not vary with execution context.

graph.saveDefinitionFirst.zh-CN: 计算已修改，请先保存指标。
graph.saveDefinitionFirst.en-US: The calculation changed. Save the indicator first.

graph.layoutOnly.zh-CN: 只保存布局，不增加指标版本。
graph.layoutOnly.en-US: Save layout only, without creating an indicator revision.

graph.defaultInstructions.zh-CN: 点击节点编辑参数；拖动端口连接依赖。
graph.defaultInstructions.en-US: Click a node to edit its parameters; drag ports to connect dependencies.

graph.emptyHint.zh-CN: 从节点库添加节点，或载入一个可修改的流程。
graph.emptyHint.en-US: Add nodes from the library or load an editable workflow.

graph.constantSync.zh-CN: 这里修改的是相连的常量节点，画布与参数同步更新。
graph.constantSync.en-US: This edits the connected constant node. The graph and parameter update together.

graph.sharedConstant.zh-CN: 此常量被 {{count}} 处引用，修改会同步影响这些输入。
graph.sharedConstant.en-US: This constant is referenced {{count}} times; editing it changes all those inputs.

home.title.zh-CN: 公募基金量化投研流程

home.description.zh-CN: 产品研究持续沉淀可复用产品池；投前形成研究目标组合，外部批准后在组合中心登记为真实组合；投中、基金会计和投后共享同一真实组合身份与业务事实。
home.description.en-US: Product research builds reusable product pools. Investment planning creates target portfolios; externally approved portfolios are registered in the portfolio center. Execution, accounting and monitoring share the same portfolio identity and business facts.

home.enterHint.zh-CN: 点击节点进入对应业务页面
home.enterHint.en-US: Select a stage to open its workspace

home.feedback.zh-CN: 反馈与迭代回流至产品研究
home.feedback.en-US: Review and iteration feed back into product research

home.feedbackHint.zh-CN: 投资结果回流至产品复审、产品池版本、配置模型和流程规则，但不会要求每个组合重新开展完整产品研究。
home.feedbackHint.en-US: Results inform product reviews, pool versions, allocation models and process rules without requiring a complete research restart for each portfolio.

home.portfolioTitle.zh-CN: 组合中心 · 真实组合库

home.portfolioDescription.zh-CN: 承接外部已批准的研究方案，统一登记真实组合、账户、核算主体、会计账簿与目标版本关系。这里创建的是平台主数据，不代表法律设立、开户或下单。
home.portfolioDescription.en-US: Register externally approved proposals, actual portfolios, accounts, accounting entities, books and target versions. Registration creates platform master data, not legal entities, accounts or orders.

home.portfolioScope.zh-CN: 覆盖范围：真实组合登记 · 组合主数据 · 账户与账簿关系 · 研究方案及目标版本 · 生命周期状态
home.portfolioScope.en-US: Scope: portfolio registration · master data · accounts and books · proposals and targets · lifecycle status

home.accountingTitle.zh-CN: 基金会计与管理人账务

home.accountingDescription.zh-CN: Booking 是已发生业务事实入口，不等于会计凭证。规则按核算主体生成各自借贷平衡的凭证，经过账、估值、核对和关账形成 ABOR 与绩效数据。
home.accountingDescription.en-US: Bookings record business facts, not accounting entries. Rules produce balanced entries for each entity, followed by posting, valuation, reconciliation and closing to form accounting and performance records.

home.accountingScope.zh-CN: 核算链路：业务 Booking → 会计确认与分类 → 复式凭证 → 总账/明细账 → 估值与关账 → 报表与 PBOR
home.accountingScope.en-US: Accounting workflow: bookings → recognition and classification → double-entry journals → ledgers → valuation and closing → statements and PBOR

home.supportTitle.zh-CN: 研究成果应用与平台支撑

home.supportDescription.zh-CN: 以下能力独立于单组合生命周期：一个负责展示研究成果，一个负责提供平台公共能力。
home.supportDescription.en-US: These capabilities sit outside an individual portfolio lifecycle: presenting research results and providing shared platform services.

home.solutionsDescription.zh-CN: 将已定稿组合转换为标准化展示版本，统一呈现组合画像、实盘与回测、周期情景、算法规则和风险披露。
home.solutionsDescription.en-US: Publish finalized portfolios as standardized presentations covering profiles, live and backtested performance, scenarios, algorithms and risk disclosures.

home.solutionsScope.zh-CN: 展示范围：方案目录 · 组合画像 · 收益与风险 · 回测与情景 · 披露版本
home.solutionsScope.en-US: Scope: solution catalog · profiles · returns and risk · backtests and scenarios · disclosure versions

home.settingsDescription.zh-CN: 数据源与快照、指标与模型、情景算法、统一回测和系统参数在这里集中管理，为五个业务阶段提供一致能力。
home.settingsDescription.en-US: Centrally manage data sources, snapshots, indicators, models, scenarios, backtesting and system parameters for consistent services across the five business stages.

home.settingsScope.zh-CN: 公共能力：数据与 PIT · 指标与模型 · 情景算法 · 统一回测 · 系统参数
home.settingsScope.en-US: Shared services: data and PIT · indicators and models · scenarios · backtesting · system parameters

app.home.zh-CN: 基金量化投研平台主页

navigation.viewAll.zh-CN: 查看本阶段全部流程节点
navigation.viewAll.en-US: View all steps in this stage

common.page.zh-CN: 第 {{page}} / {{pages}} 页 · 共 {{total}} 项

common.unsavedConfirm.zh-CN: 当前有未保存修改，放弃修改并继续？

i18n.description.zh-CN: 系统语言包只读；业务术语可以自定义。显示名称变化不会修改公式、内部标识或计算结果。
i18n.description.en-US: System language packs are read-only. Business terminology can be customized without changing formulas, identifiers or results.

i18n.browserHint.zh-CN: 只影响当前浏览器，不改变币种、时区、计算精度或其他人的语言偏好。
i18n.browserHint.en-US: Affects this browser only, not currency, time zone, calculation precision or another user's preference.

i18n.defaultHint.zh-CN: 影响尚未单独设置语言的浏览器。业务翻译在当前工作区共享；本系统尚无独立的翻译管理员角色。
i18n.defaultHint.en-US: Applies to browsers without a language preference. Business translations are shared in this workspace; there is no separate translation administrator role.

i18n.defaultSaved.zh-CN: 工作区默认语言已保存。

i18n.systemHint.zh-CN: 菜单、按钮和系统提示由内置语言包维护。此表没有修改入口；业务导入和接口也不能覆盖这里的词条。
i18n.systemHint.en-US: Menus, buttons and system messages are maintained in built-in packs. These entries cannot be changed through business imports or APIs.

i18n.businessHint.zh-CN: 这里只修改业务名称和说明。指标名称、步骤备注等用户原始内容不会自动翻译。清空自定义值后保存即可恢复默认。
i18n.businessHint.en-US: Edit business names and descriptions only. User-authored indicator names and notes are not translated. Clear an override and save to restore the default.

i18n.matrix.searchHint.zh-CN: 搜索系统代码或任意语言译文
i18n.matrix.searchHint.en-US: Search system code or any language translation

i18n.importHint.zh-CN: 只合并列出的业务词条，不删除文件中未提及的覆盖；空值表示恢复默认。系统词条禁止导入。
i18n.importHint.en-US: Merges the listed business entries only; unlisted overrides are kept. A null value resets an entry. System entries cannot be imported.

i18n.invalidFile.zh-CN: 文件不是有效的业务翻译包，或超过 1 MB。
i18n.invalidFile.en-US: The file is not a valid business translation pack, or exceeds 1 MB.

i18n.restoreConfirm.zh-CN: 将业务翻译恢复到修订 {{revision}}？这会创建一个新修订，不改变系统翻译和语言偏好。
i18n.restoreConfirm.en-US: Restore business translations to revision {{revision}}? This creates a new revision and does not change system translations or language preferences.

i18n.historyHint.zh-CN: 保留最近 50 个业务修订，恢复历史会产生新修订。
i18n.historyHint.en-US: The most recent 50 business revisions are retained. Restoring creates a new revision.

i18n.offline.zh-CN: 翻译服务暂不可用，正在使用当前可用词条。共享修改需恢复连接后保存。
i18n.offline.en-US: Translation service is unavailable. Currently loaded entries remain usable. Reconnect to save shared changes.

i18n.conflict.zh-CN: 翻译已被其他操作更新。你的草稿已保留；请刷新词条并核对后再保存。
i18n.conflict.en-US: Translations were updated elsewhere. Your draft is preserved; refresh and review before saving.

i18n.coverage.zh-CN: 已登记词条：{{total}}；本语言缺失：{{missing}}。此统计不代表所有旧页面已迁移。
i18n.coverage.en-US: Registered entries: {{total}}; missing in this language: {{missing}}. This does not imply all legacy pages have been migrated.

i18n.scopeWarning.zh-CN: 菜单、语言设置和已接入的业务标签支持即时切换。未迁移的旧页面文案保留原文，不自动翻译用户内容。
i18n.scopeWarning.en-US: Menus, language settings and integrated business labels update immediately. Unmigrated legacy text remains unchanged; user content is never automatically translated.

i18n.validation.zh-CN: 译文校验未通过，请检查内容、长度和占位符。
i18n.validation.en-US: Translation validation failed. Check text, length and placeholders.

graph.hint.zh-CN: 变量与常量 → 计算算子 → 指标输出；点击节点编辑，参数与常量节点同步。
graph.hint.en-US: Variables and constants → operators → outputs. Click a node to edit it; parameters and constant nodes stay synchronized.

graph.instructions.zh-CN: 拖动节点排布，拖动端口连接；也可点击节点后下拉选择上游。Shift 框选，Ctrl/⌘+Z 撤销。
graph.instructions.en-US: Drag nodes to arrange and ports to connect, or choose an upstream step in its settings. Shift selects; Ctrl/⌘+Z undoes.

graph.resourceHint.zh-CN: 点击添加，或拖到画布指定位置。已有指标会展开成独立步骤。
graph.resourceHint.en-US: Click to add or drag to the canvas. Existing indicators expand into independent steps.

graph.formulas.zh-CN: 查看生成公式与数据依赖

graph.dependencies.zh-CN: 数据依赖：{{names}}。这里只做结构检查，实际数据覆盖和数值结果在“校验与预览”中确认。
graph.dependencies.en-US: Dependencies: {{names}}. This checks structure only. Confirm data coverage and numerical results in Validation and preview.

graph.noteHint.zh-CN: 可选，说明这一步做什么

primitiveAuthoring.singleHint.zh-CN: 一个指标对应一个结果。分别选择多个指标时，系统自动复用相同的计算步骤。
primitiveAuthoring.singleHint.en-US: Each metric has one result. Selected metrics reuse identical calculation steps automatically.

primitiveAuthoring.stateHint.zh-CN: 这是共享计算的中间结果。请连接字段提取算子，再生成一个独立指标结果。
primitiveAuthoring.stateHint.en-US: This is an intermediate computation state. Use a field projection to produce one independent metric result.

graph.minimap.zh-CN: 计算图缩略导航，可拖动定位节点
graph.minimap.en-US: Graph minimap. Drag to locate nodes.

indicator.export.zh-CN: 下载 Excel 计算逻辑

errors.GRAPH_CYCLE.zh-CN: 连接形成循环，请断开回到上游的连线。
errors.GRAPH_CYCLE.en-US: This connection creates a cycle. Remove the connection back to an upstream node.

errors.UNKNOWN_NODE.zh-CN: 连接指向不存在的步骤，请重新选择上游。
errors.UNKNOWN_NODE.en-US: The connection references a missing step. Select another upstream node.

errors.UNUSED_NODE.zh-CN: 部分步骤未接入最终输出，请连接或删除。
errors.UNUSED_NODE.en-US: Some steps are not connected to an output. Connect or delete them.

errors.INVALID_CONSTANT.zh-CN: 请填写有效的有限常量。

errors.AXIS_MISMATCH.zh-CN: 输入数据的对齐维度不匹配。
errors.AXIS_MISMATCH.en-US: Input data axes do not match.

errors.PRICE_BASIS_MISMATCH.en-US: The input price bases are incompatible.

errors.SEMANTIC_DIMENSION_MISMATCH.en-US: The input semantic dimensions are incompatible.

errors.OUTPUT_NOT_CONNECTED.en-US: Select a source for the final output.

errors.REVISION_CONFLICT.zh-CN: 版本已被其他操作更新，请刷新后重试。
errors.REVISION_CONFLICT.en-US: The revision was updated elsewhere. Refresh and retry.

errors.I18N_REVISION_CONFLICT.zh-CN: 翻译已更新，你的草稿已保留，请刷新后核对。
errors.I18N_REVISION_CONFLICT.en-US: Translations were updated elsewhere. Your draft is preserved; refresh and review.

errors.I18N_SYSTEM_READ_ONLY.zh-CN: 系统词条由内置语言包维护，不能修改。
errors.I18N_SYSTEM_READ_ONLY.en-US: System entries are maintained in built-in packs and cannot be modified.

errors.I18N_INVALID_IMPORT.zh-CN: 导入格式、确认摘要或词条内容无效。
errors.I18N_INVALID_IMPORT.en-US: Invalid import format, confirmation digest or translation entries.

errors.I18N_INVALID_ENTRY.zh-CN: 业务译文无效，请检查词条、文本长度和占位符。
errors.I18N_INVALID_ENTRY.en-US: Invalid business translation. Check the entry, text length and placeholders.
